method.time: tΣ is summed GPU-0 trace duration for every kernel in the displayed branch; it is not wall span, and overlap remains additive.
method.mfu: MFU uses static GLM-5.2 model math normalized to the B300 dense FP4 reference: native NVFP4 ×1, FP8 ×3, and BF16 ×6.
method.mbu: MBUmin uses modeled useful bytes and the 8 TB/s B300 reference bandwidth. It is not Nsight Compute measured DRAM traffic, and cache hits, transactions, workspace, and unmodeled support traffic can make the physical value differ in either direction.
method.precision: Precision mapping follows the established Neimeng NVFP4 ledger and raw E4M3/E2M1 kernel evidence; it is not an Nsight Compute hardware-counter measurement.
method.classification: Layer boundaries come from the repeated q-lora/kv-lora RMSNorm motif and two TP reductions per layer. A1.1–A1.8 additionally use within-layer order and split-K adjacency to disambiguate reused raw names; all operation children reconcile exactly to A1.
